analysis.headline: MapQuest adds a layer showing Flock surveillance camera locations
analysis.summary: MapQuest's app now displays the locations of Flock and other automated license-plate-reader cameras, letting users see nearby surveillance points. Outlets describe the feature as helping people identify or avoid these cameras while driving.
